sql: WITH a AS (SELECT i.seller_id,COUNT(*) joined_items,SUM(i.price) joined_sales,AVG(i.price) joined_price,AVG(r.review_score*1.0) review_mean,AVG(julianday(o.order_delivered_carrier_date)-julianday(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) purchase_pack,AVG(julianday(o.order_delivered_carrier_date)-julianday(o.order_approved_at)) approve_pack FROM order_items i LEFT JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id=i.order_id LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=i.order_id GROUP BY i.seller_id) SELECT COUNT(*) sellers,SUM(joined_items) joined_items,SUM(joined_sales) joined_sales FROM a WHERE joined_items>100
